{"status": "ok", "comment": "Fixed the tagging bug in tagger/notes.py by removing the shared mutable default argument and initializing a fresh list per call, so tags never bleed between notes.", "file_path": "tagger/notes.py", "content": """"Tagging helpers for notes."""


def add_tag(note: dict, tag: str, tags: list[str] | None = None) -> list[str]:
    """Attach ``tag`` to ``note`` and return the tag list.

    Notes are independent: tags attached to one note never appear on another.
    An explicit ``tags`` list may be supplied to share one list deliberately.
    """
    if tags is None:
        tags = []
    tags.append(tag)
    note["tags"] = tags
    return tags
